description: The fifth edition of the conclave, to be held in Lucknow on October 30, will feature Deputy Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Brajesh Pathak, IT & Electronics Minister Sunil Kumar Sharma, and Social Welfare Minister Asim Arun.
body_lead: Lucknow, October 29: Uttar Pradesh’s push to become a $1 trillion economy will be in focus at the fifth edition of the ETGovernment Vision Conclave 5.0 on Friday, with policymakers, technology leaders, financial institutions and industry representatives set to deliberate on how artificial intelligence (AI), advanced manufacturing and digital infrastructure can accelerate the state’s economic transformation.
